definitions.explanation: Something forbidden by custom or religion; in medicine, a situation in which a drug or treatment must not be used.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁忌|きんき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{妊婦|にんぷ}→妊婦：20357_ninpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁忌|きんき}だ。
examples.english: This drug is contraindicated for pregnant women.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{死者|ししゃ}→死者：13225_shisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}にする→口にする：21471_kuchinisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禁忌|きんき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: In many cultures, speaking the names of the dead has been treated as taboo.

notes:
USAGE:
- In everyday talk, タブー is the usual word for a social taboo; {禁忌|きんき} is written and formal, and it is the standard term on drug labels and in medicine ({併用禁忌|へいようきんき}, must not be taken together).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁忌|きんき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be considered taboo
- {禁忌|きんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧: to break a taboo
- {併用禁忌|へいようきんき}: (of drugs) must not be combined
- {禁忌|きんき}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: contraindications (on a package insert)
